Based on the retrieved knowledge, here is a summary of your resume [Source 1]: You are a B.Tech CSE student with strong foundations in Data Structures, Algorithms, and Object-Oriented Programming, experienced in building scalable full-stack applications and backend systems. You are passionate about solving real-world problems using technology and interested in applying software engineering in financial services and large-scale systems.

Your work experience [Source 2] includes a Summer Research Intern position at SRM University-AP, where you built an end-to-end ML system to predict credit scores and deployed an interactive Streamlit dashboard. You are also a Core Team Member at Google Developer Groups (GDG), where you tracked registration data, increased participant engagement, and led campaigns to reach students.

Your technical skills [Source 3] include proficiency in programming languages such as Python, JavaScript, C, C++, and Java, as well as experience with web technologies, backend frameworks, databases, machine learning, and data science tools.

You also have certifications [Source 4] in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Java SE 17 Developer, and MongoDB Certified Associate Developer.

Note that [Source 5] appears to be a medical report and is not relevant to your resume summary. If you would like me to focus on specific aspects of your resume, please let me know.
